description.p: NanoTorrent is a small BitTorrent client: a Rust port of PicoTorrent by Viktor Elofsson, built on librqbit.

ul.li: DHT, UDP trackers and MSE/PE protocol encryption
Add several torrents at once, choosing which files to fetch from each
Create torrents in BitTorrent v1, v2 or hybrid format
Labels, and filters written in a small query language
Per-torrent details: files, peers with country flags, and trackers by announce tier
An optional authenticated HTTPS web interface for controlling it remotely
Available in over 40 languages, switchable without restarting

screenshot.caption: The torrent list, with the details pane below it

description.p: Strict network mode: when a VPN interface or a SOCKS proxy is set, NanoTorrent switches off whatever that cannot cover — DHT, uTP, local peer discovery and UPnP — refuses to start if the interface is missing, and pauses everything if it disappears while running. Binding to an interface now works on Windows.
Security fix: a malicious .torrent whose filename carried a drive prefix could write outside the download folder on Windows.

The web interface gains the desktop toolbar, speed charts, resizable columns, multi-select, drag-and-drop adding, a configurable login lockout, and plugin control. Fixes dialogs that could open taller than the screen.
Plugins can reach the network, keep their own data, and open a window and a menu of their own. Includes an RSS feed reader as a plugin. Adds live download and upload charts to the toolbar.

Adds the plugin host: optional Rhai scripts that watch torrents and drive them, each declaring what it may reach and running only once approved. Plugins are off by default. Finishes desktop notifications on all three platforms.
BitTorrent v2 (BEP 52) and hybrid torrents, including v2 magnets. Adds the fast extension (BEP 6), upload-only (BEP 21), and per-tracker announce statistics.
Set a torrent's save path without moving its files, for data relocated outside the app. Fixes a burst of download-complete notifications when starting with completed torrents.

Adds a resizable details panel with per-version info hashes, advanced HTTP tuning and login rate limiting for the web interface, and completes the translations for all 41 languages. Fixes a progress bar that could read 100% before a torrent had finished, and a durability bug that could lose verified pieces after an unclean exit.

ul.li: Opening a torrent's download folder opened the parent directory instead, and reported nothing when it failed
The window icon fell back to a generic one on Wayland
The notification-area icon could not be created in sandboxed environments

description.p: Fixes a crash on startup: turning off the notification-area icon made the application fail to launch every time afterwards, with no way to undo it from the interface.
The "Skip 'Add torrent' dialog" preference now works - it was stored but never acted on.
Batch torrent adding in both the desktop and web interfaces, a low-disk guard, and fixes for two bugs in session persistence.
